decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom is only now being released, with US availability set for Q1/2019, so its value is still uncertain and the option is worth keeping open.
Small volume chambers are core dosimetry products that cost little to keep listed and still have uncertain upside in small-field dosimetry, so the option is worth holding.
This second small volume chamber overlaps somewhat with B, but the carrying cost is low and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
The standard clinical chamber line with several models is a staple product with steady demand and low carrying cost.
The relative dosimetry chamber complements the water phantom systems and costs little to maintain while its prospects play out.
Thimble chambers are basic catalog items with low carrying cost and no negative signals so far.
